notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
description:
Activate Perilous Forays by paying {1} and sacrificing a creature you control, searching your library for a land card with a basic land type and putting it on the battlefield untapped.
When the land enters the battlefield, Curse of the Restless Dead and Amulet of Vigor trigger.
Resolve the Curse of the Restless Dead trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Amulet of Vigor trigger, untapping the land.
Activate the land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Repeat.
